title: Kalaignar and Karuthiruman: “Not in the Graveyard; With You in the Assembly!”
summary: When Karuthiruman teased about the old slogan 'Dravida Nadu or the graveyard' asking if they were now in the graveyard, Kalaignar replied: 'No, we are right here sitting with you in the Assembly!'
keywords: Kalaignar and Karuthiruman: “Not in the Graveyard; With You in the Assembly!”
Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi & P. G. Karuthiruman
full_text:
In 1969, following the demise of Arignar Anna, Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi assumed the office of Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.

The Leader of the Opposition was Congress stalwart P. G. Karuthiruman, a seasoned orator with an incisive wit.

During a debate on policy consistency, Karuthiruman decided to taunt the young Chief Minister with past rhetoric:
"Mr. Chief Minister! In your early years, your party raised an emotional slogan across every platform: 'Either we attain Dravida Nadu, or we go to the graveyard!'
Now, having abandoned the separate state demand, you are comfortably seated on the treasury benches. Where is that graveyard you promised? Are you currently residing in the graveyard?"

Congress benches broke into gleeful laughter.

Karunanidhi rose smoothly from his seat, a playful smile curling his lips:
"Mr. Speaker! My esteemed friend Karuthiruman has inquired about our whereabouts with great concern, asking if we are in the graveyard.
I shall give him a very simple and direct answer:
No, friend Karuthiruman! We are certainly not in the graveyard; we are right here, sitting comfortably alongside you in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly!"

The assembly chamber exploded into roaring laughter!

The double entendre was brilliant: while Karunanidhi meant they were physically present in parliament, the implication that sitting with the opposition was equivalent to the graveyard left Karuthiruman himself grinning in admiration.

By refusing to get angry and meeting sarcasm with sparkling wit, Karunanidhi kept assembly debates lively, memorable, and cultured.
moral: Effortlessly neutralizing opposition taunts through instantaneous double entendre and good-natured comedic delivery.
